A new pure module `src/best.ts` holds the logic, `main.ts` and `index.html` get small edits, and tests are Vitest unit tests plus Playwright journeys. I also did not run anything, as this seat has no shell. A reader must know that the HUD placement is a changeable default, and that "session" means the tab session.
